Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Class MailpitTestConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport.MailpitTestConfiguration
@TestConfiguration(proxyBeanMethods=false) public class MailpitTestConfiguration extends Object
Starts a Mailpit container for a Spring test context and points the application's mail sender at it, so the messages the application sends can be read back through MailpitClient. Import it next to PostgresTestConfiguration.
